repository_acceptance_note: Merged PR #84 accepted the eight IC records as repository reference records and the three RD records as roadmap records. Mathematical status, proof residency, and record-specific review requirements remain independent.

promotion_semantics.candidate_in_draft_pr: Selected by an unmerged integration draft; not accepted into main.
promotion_semantics.accepted_reference_record: Accepted on main as the repository reference statement; a local proof packet or narrow synthesis review may still be pending.
promotion_semantics.accepted_with_local_proof: Accepted on main and accompanied by a readable local proof or exact proof extract.
promotion_semantics.roadmap_candidate_in_draft_pr: Selected roadmap record in an unmerged draft.
promotion_semantics.roadmap_accepted: Accepted roadmap or obligation on main; this does not mean the obligation is solved.
promotion_semantics.retired: No longer active, with a durable supersession or migration record.
